items.headline: North Korea ne Russia ko hathiyar dena roka
items.detail: Ukraine ki khufia agency GUR ke mutabik Kim Jong Un ne Russia ko KN-23 missile aur golabarud dena roka, aur Russian sainya vimanon ke liye apna hawai kshetra band kar diya.
items.exam_angle: North Korea-Russia sainya sahyog, Ukraine yuddh

items.headline: Nvidia ne 4 deshon ko server bhejna roka
items.detail: America ke naye export control ke baad Nvidia ne Dell aur Supermicro se kaha Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand aur Indonesia ko AI server na bhejein, taaki China ko chip na mile.
items.exam_angle: America ke AI chip export control aur China ko chip se rokna

items.headline: 3.5 arab password aur record khule me mile
items.detail: Do asurakshit database se 3.5 arab se zyada username, password aur vyaktigat record mile — ek me lagbhag 2 arab login credential, dusre me 84 crore se zyada Chinese ID number.

items.headline: Netanyahu Case 4000: judge ne hatane ko kaha
items.detail: Israel ki adalat ne Netanyahu ke bhrashtachar mukadme ke sabse gambhir Case 4000 ko hatane ka sujhav diya, kaha dosh siddh hone ki sambhavna kam hai; Attorney General vichar karengi.

items.headline: Trump ne Putin se hamle rokne ko kaha
items.detail: America ke rashtrapati Trump ne kaha unhone China me Putin se Europe bhar me sainya hamle rokne ko kaha, taaki Russia-Ukraine samjhota jald ho sake; unhone yuddh ko 'complete bloodbath' bataya.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, Trump-Putin vartalap — UPSC IR

items.headline: Ramaphosa ko court se badi rahat mili
items.detail: South Africa ki Western Cape High Court ne 2022 ki Phala Phala panel report ko gair-kanuni batakar radd kar diya; isse Ramaphosa ke khilaf mahabhiyog jaanch khatm ho gayi.
items.exam_angle: South Africa, Phala Phala, mahabhiyog — UPSC IR

items.headline: Kim ne tactical parmanu hathiyar badhane ko kaha
items.detail: North Korea ke neta Kim Jong Un ne parmanu samagri utpadan badhane aur tactical parmanu hathiyaron ko kai kshetron me tainat karne ko kaha; unhone desh ki parmanu sthiti ko aparivartaniya bataya.
items.exam_angle: North Korea, parmanu hathiyar, KCNA — UPSC IR

items.headline: Har ghante 5 mahilayein apno se mari
items.detail: UN ki 2026 Femicide Brief ke mutabik 2025 me duniya bhar me lagbhag 47,000 mahilayein aur ladkiyan saathi ya parivar ke haathon mari gayin — har ghante lagbhag paanch; kul 78,000 me se 60% maamle ghar ke andar hue.
items.exam_angle: UN Women, UNODC, femicide — UPSC samaj

items.headline: America me toofan, 7 lakh ghar andhere me
items.detail: Thanksgiving par America ke purvi hisse me toofan se 7.24 lakh se zyada gharon ki bijli chali gayi aur lagbhag 400 udanein radd hui; New York ki Macy's parade 100 saal me pehli baar sthagit hui. (Updated: bijli aur udaan ke aankde badhe)

items.headline: Kuwait me drone hamla, 2 Italian mare
items.detail: Kuwait ke hawai raksha kendra par drone hamle me do Italian technician mare gaye aur do log ghayal hue; Kuwait aur Italy ne Iran ko zimmedar bataya, Iran ne inkar kiya.
items.exam_angle: Iran-Kuwait tanav, Hormuz sankat — UPSC IR

items.headline: Ibiza ke paas tanker palta, 1 ki maut
items.detail: Spain ke Ibiza ke paas diesel bhara Malta-flag tanker Med Emre palat gaya; 17 crew me se 1 ki maut hui, 6 ghayal; abhi tel risaav nahi mila, Spain ne pradushan-roktham yojana shuru ki.

items.headline: Colombia supermarket bandhak sankat khatm, sab surakshit
items.detail: Cartagena ke supermarket me 16 ghante ke bandhak sankat ke baad suraksha balon ne sabhi bandhakon ko surakshit chhudaya; ek hamlaawar mara gaya aur baaki giraftar hue.

items.headline: Zelensky ki chetavni: Russia bada hamla karega
items.detail: Ukraine ke rashtrapati Zelensky ne kaha Russia aane wale dinon me bada hamla karne ki taiyari kar raha hai; unhone logo se missile chetavni par dhyan dene ko kaha.

items.headline: ECB ke naye pramukh bane De Cos
items.detail: Eurozone deshon ne Spain ke Pablo Hernandez de Cos ko European Central Bank ka agla pramukh chuna; woh February me Christine Lagarde ki jagah lenge aur pehle Spanish ECB pramukh honge.

items.headline: Bangkok refinery me dhamaka, 9 ghayal
items.detail: Bangkok ki Bangchak refinery me dhamaka aur aag lagi, kam se kam 9 log ghayal hue aur aas-paas ke logon ko evacuate karaya gaya; aag par kabu pa liya gaya, wajah ki jaanch jaari hai.

items.headline: Cairo tanker aag ka driver giraftar
items.detail: Egypt ne us driver ko giraftar kiya jispar tanker se takkar ka aarop hai; usne 110 km/h par gaadi chalane ki baat mani; haadse me 31 ki maut aur 21 ghayal hue the.

items.headline: Manchester concert gas ka chori se link
items.detail: Manchester me Don Toliver ke concert me anjaan gas chhodne se 12,000 log evacuate hue aur 89 logon me lakshan dikhe, ek ko hospital le jaya gaya; police ko chori ki 9 shikayatein mili hain aur gas ka chori se link ho sakta hai.

items.headline: Iran ka prastav: Hormuz 48 ghante me khulega
items.detail: Tehran ne Qatar ke madhyam se America ko prastav bheja — nausainik nakabandi hate aur har morche par ladai ruke to Hormuz Strait 48 ghante ke andar phir se khul jayega.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz Strait, Iran-America tanav — UPSC IR

items.headline: Kremlin ka Ukraine par yuddh badhane ka aarop
items.detail: Kremlin pravakta Dmitry Peskov ne kaha Ukraine yuddh ko Mediterranean aur Baltic sagar tak badha raha hai; ye bayan America aur NATO pramukh ki sanyukt chetavni ke baad aaya.

items.headline: UK net migration 1997 ke baad sabse kam
items.detail: ONS ke mutabik June 2026 tak ke saal me UK ki net migration 77,000 rahi, 1997 ke baad sabse kam; pichhle saal ye 204,000 thi.
items.exam_angle: UK pravasan, ONS aankde — UPSC IR

items.headline: Zaporizhzhia me drone hamla, 5 ki maut
items.detail: Russia-niyukt Zaporizhzhia governor Yevgeny Balitsky ke mutabik Ukraine ke drone ne Vesioloye me parking par hamla kiya, 5 log mare aur 3 ghayal hue.

items.headline: Russia-Ukraine ka sabse bada kaidi adla-badli jald
items.detail: America ke vishesh doot Jared Kushner ne kaha ki Russia aur Ukraine ke beech yuddh ka sabse bada kaidi adla-badli Christmas se pehle hoga; hazaron log apne parivaron ke paas lautenge.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, kaidi adla-badli, Abu Dhabi vartalap — UPSC IR
items.image_credit: US Mission to the European Union, Wikimedia Commons (Public domain)

items.headline: North Korea ne Swiss doot ko nikala
items.detail: North Korea ne Pyongyang sthit Switzerland ke rajnaitik karyalaya ko band karne aur uske pramukh Sylvain Astier ko 48 ghante me desh chhodne ka aadesh diya; wajah Switzerland ka ek bachchon ke shivir par pratibandh hai.
items.exam_angle: North Korea, Switzerland, pratibandh, Ukraine ke bachche — UPSC IR

items.headline: EU neta saat saal ke budget par bante
items.detail: Brussels me EU ke 27 neta 2028–2034 ke lagbhag 1.6 lakh crore euro ke budget aur Ukraine ke liye 45 arab euro ke naye karz par bante hue hain; samjhota December me hone ki ummeed hai.
items.exam_angle: EU budget, MFF, Ukraine vitt — UPSC IR
